svg.title: IPC between WebKit's processes, one arrow per direction (WebKit-7621.2.5.11.8)
svg.desc: The UI process launches and supervises the WebContent, Networking, GPU and helper processes. Each process runs inside its own sandbox, drawn as a shell around its box; on iOS all of them are also checked against the system-wide platform profile. The operating system runs underneath.

g.text: Safari, or any app embedding WKWebView
window, tabs, address bar, permission prompts
launches and supervises the other processes
macOS / iOS: system daemons (Mach services), drivers (IOKit), kernel (enforces every sandbox)
trust = rating based on how exposed the process is to an attacker
IPC directions in the Safari 18.5 tag (interfaces, messages)
